# Recreation Prompt

Recreate the game as **Haddonfield: Shape at the Door**, a mobile-first portrait canvas survival-evasion game based on this prompt: Halloween slasher survival. A Halloween slasher survival game with Michael Myers stalking, suburban autumn dread, slow unstoppable pursuit, silent terror, masked menace, and classic seasonal horror tension with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The player controls a survivor with a flashlight by holding or dragging on the canvas. The survivor must collect all glowing porch keys scattered along a suburban Halloween street. Each collection increases tension. After tension rises, The Shape, a silent masked slasher in a dark suit, begins an unstoppable slow pursuit. If the Shape remains close long enough, a mask scare appears and the caught state ends the run. If all keys are collected, the survivor reaches the final porch and escapes. Preserve the source mechanics exactly while expressing the world through procedural houses, pumpkins, leaves, streetlights, mask silhouette, readable HUD badges, and touch-friendly restart.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
The source is a browser canvas survival-evasion collection game. A player avatar starts near the lower playfield, moves toward pointer/touch targets, collects a configured number of objects, and is pressured by a pursuing horror entity after threat rises. Collecting all objects wins/escapes. Contact with the pursuer after a short close timer triggers a scare/failure state. Restart resets the same loop.

## Protected mechanics
- Canvas runtime and animation loop.
- Pointer/touch target movement semantics.
- Player speed config, boundary clamping, collectible spawn count, collectible contact radius.
- Threat increases over time and on collection.
- Pursuer activates only after threat threshold and chases with warmup.
- Close-distance timer before caught state.
- Escape when all collectibles are gathered; caught failure when pursuer reaches player; restart resets.

## Transformable surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title, background drawing, entity silhouettes, collectible appearance, modal copy, palette, fonts, audio selection, feedback overlays, and procedural props are presentation-only and safe to transform.

## Remix target
A portrait-first Halloween slasher survival scene: survivor with flashlight gathers porch keys while The Shape silently stalks through suburban autumn streets.
